input.contract_name: Janitorial Services – County Facilities (Groups A, B, C and D)
input.notes: Coquina County Board of County Commissioners, Florida Gulf coast. Facilities at the Government Center campus (Marlow Springs) and branch sites in Westshore, Palm Hollow, Cypress Point and Pine Ridge; one county-wide facility numbering. Initial term 3 years (Feb 1, 2027 - Jan 31, 2030) plus two 1-year renewals, max 5 years (ITB 1.3). Award by Group (A-D), monthly price x 36. Janitorial only; no grounds. Climate inferred from location (Florida Gulf coast).

input.notes: Awarded by the Board Dec 14, 2021 under ITB 21-031; initial 3-year term from Feb 1, 2022 with two 1-year renewals, both exercised; expires Jan 31, 2027 (60 months total, ITB 1.2). annual_value = FY 2025-26 expenditures (Oct 1, 2025 - Sep 30, 2026). spend_to_date covers Feb 1, 2022 - Sep 30, 2026 (56 months). Award/ceiling value not stated. Caveat (A2): current contract covers 28 of the facilities in this ITB, excludes Judicial Center day porters, and includes Additional Services work orders; County says not a basis for pricing.

input.summary: Coquina County ITB 27-014 Janitorial Services (Groups A-D). Registered all 31 Attachment A Facility List rows (ATT-A-FL, 812,790 gross SF as printed), the 2 optional facilities O-1/O-2 as option_only (ATT-A-OPT), and the 31 Periodic Services rows (ATT-A-PS: carpet / hard floor / wood gym SF and periodic frequencies in notes). Addendum No. 1 applied: 101 and 202 re-measured (gross/cleanable and floor SF), 208 to Mon-Fri, 403 to Weekly (Wed), 309 deleted, 210 Veterans and Human Services Office added to Group B (7,920 gross / 7,140 cleanable). In scope: 31 facilities, 819,950 gross / 607,815 cleanable SF per Addendum Item 3. No grounds scope. Incumbent Gulfview Facility Services, Inc., C21-0457, FY2025-26 spend $1,146,820.
unresolved: Out-of-scope facilities named only in narrative (ITB 2.2, Attachment A Note 6), not registered: Coquina County Detention Facility, fourteen (14) Fire Rescue stations, Coquina County Civic Center, Marlow Springs Airport terminal.

Facility 105 ballot warehouse (28,340 SF) is cleaned only as ordered Additional Services (before/after elections); EOC (106) activation cleaning, post-storm cleanup and special events are also Additional Services at hourly rates - no quantities stated.
O-1 Fairgrounds Exhibition Hall is per-event cleaning (Option Item 1) with no number of events per year stated.
Facility 404 second summer service (Memorial Day through Labor Day): additional service days estimated at 99/yr; the document gives the window, not a day count.
Restroom fixture counts are not available (Attachment A Note 3, Addendum A3); only restroom room counts were registered.
Judicial Center (102) two day porters Mon-Fri 7:30 AM - 4:00 PM are included in the Group A price; recorded in notes only.
Incumbent spend covers 28 of the facilities, excludes day porters and includes Additional Services (Addendum A2); no award or ceiling value stated.
